thesis: This episode argues that Benchmark Partners made exceptional, high-conviction bets on dot-com era companies like Webvan and Microsoft, as well as later-stage winners like Uber and Snap, often identifying their value dynamics before the broader investing world. It highlights the firm's unique partnership structure where every partner has equal carry and emphasizes specific investments that were incubated in their offices or achieved massive profitability, even if some eventually went liquid.
